mapper.select: SELECT user_id, family, address_index, address FROM wallet_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY family
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO wallet_address (user_id, family, address_index, address, address_key) VALUES (#{userId}, #{family}, #{index}, #{address}, #{key})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM wallet_address WHERE family = #{family} AND address_key = #{key}
